CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   B. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft - Beadwork.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)

   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

3. Best practice when working on Javelin and Sculpture: (1 mark)
